_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Thomas Shelton (fl. 1604-1620). Don Quixote, the first English translation (Part I 1612, Part II 1620), in the Macmillan 'Library of English Classics' reprint (1900, 3 vols). PD. Pairs with Motteux (urquhart-motteux shelf) and Ormsby. Added 2026-10-02 by lane C under the coordinator's standing instruction (choose further translator shelves); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted in the relay burst.
